meta.title: Nádražky — Czech railway station pubs
meta.description: The database of railway station pubs in the Czech Republic. Find an open station pub on your line, check in and collect badges.

home.lead: Find a nádražka on your line, have one on the platform and collect badges for regions and rail lines.

home.helpText: For most pubs we don't know if they are still open. Every on-the-spot check-in confirms it.

home.step1: Get off at the station and find the pub.
home.step2: Check in on the spot — your phone's location confirms you are there.
home.step3: Collect badges for regions and rail lines.

about.title: About
about.body: Nádražky is a database of railway station pubs in the Czech Republic where you can check in and collect badges. It is made by Prague Beer Guides.
about.dataBody: Station positions, regions and rail lines come from Wikidata (CC0). The map is based on OpenStreetMap.

notFound.title: This train doesn't stop here
notFound.body: We couldn't find that page. Try the map or the pub list.

auth.title: Log in
auth.subtitle: Log in or sign up to check in at station pubs. No passwords: use Google or a link sent to your email.
auth.adultsOnly: Nádražky is for adults: you must be 18 or over to sign up.
auth.sentText: We've sent a sign-in link to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours.
auth.sentTextNoEmail: We've sent you a sign-in link. It's valid for 24 hours.
auth.devText: Local development only: signs in with any email, no check.
auth.notConfigured: Signing in isn't set up on this server yet.

errors.OAuthAccountNotLinked: This email is already used with another sign-in method. Use that one.
errors.Verification: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

auth.finishText: Pick a username. It is shown next to your check-ins.
auth.usernameInvalid: Use 3–20 characters: letters a–z, digits and _.
auth.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
auth.adultConfirm: I confirm I am 18 or over.
auth.adultRequired: You must be 18 or over to use Nádražky.

checkIn.title: Check in
checkIn.howTitle: You need to be at the pub
checkIn.howText: When you check in, we ask your phone for its location once. You must be within 300 m of the pub. Your position isn't saved, only how far you were.

errors.geoDenied: Allow this site to use your location, then try again. Check-ins need your phone's location.
errors.geoUnavailable: Your location isn't available right now. Turn on location services or step outside, then try again.
errors.geoTimeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again.
errors.geoUnsupported: This browser can't share its location, so you can't check in with it.
errors.tooFar: You're {distance} from the pub. Check in within 300 m of it.
errors.alreadyToday: You've already checked in here today. Come back tomorrow.
errors.invalid: Something in the form isn't right. Try again.
errors.finishSignUp: Finish signing up to check in.

checkIn.alreadyText: You've already checked in at {name} today. One check-in per pub per day counts.
